summary: Server per-item animation state machine (doors, chests, levers): three 16-bit eoc::item::animation::EAnimationState values. Updated by esv::item::animation::StateTransitionSystem; read by esv::invisibility::ChangesSystem::ProcessItemAnimationStateChanges. Seen.py context: idle levels, up to 2811 holders (every animated item).

fields.name: DesiredState
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x13B1290 StateTransitionSystem::ProcessDesiredStateUpdates: for items whose eoc::item::animation::RequestComponent (4 bytes) changed, compares this +0 (stride 6) with the request's +0 and writes it here, logging 'New desired state requested'. EAnimationState (16-bit). Game name: member 0 (m_DesiredState) of savegame model ls::model::game::item::animation::v0::StateComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x504BDC0) copies the three uint16 at component +0/+2/+4 in that order into model members 0/1/2.

fields.name: CurrentState
fields.evidence: EoCServer.dll+0x13B03A0 FinalizeState switches on +2 (cases 0/4/6...), returns when +0 == +2, and after a transition writes the new state to +2 ('New DesiredState received: item current desired'). Game name: member 1 (m_CurrentState) of savegame model ls::model::game::item::animation::v0::StateComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x504BDC0) copies the three uint16 at component +0/+2/+4 in that order into model members 0/1/2.

fields.name: PreviousState
fields.evidence: Third 16-bit value, not decoded (probably the previous or target state). Live: 1 instance with 04 00 04 00 04 00. Game name: member 2 (m_PreviousState) of savegame model ls::model::game::item::animation::v0::StateComponent; matched by the macOS Save (bg3_macos_x64+0x504BDC0) copies the three uint16 at component +0/+2/+4 in that order into model members 0/1/2.

open_questions: Meaning of +4; whether +0/+2 are swapped (desired vs current) - decided from the two log strings.
